comments.comment: Hi VitaliyB, could you please fill description?
Hangs were caused by late affinity assignment after cache start.
EdShangGG, please take a look.

EdShangGG , TxOptimisticDeadlockDetectionTest and TxPessimisticDeadlockDetectionTest start transactions and generate deadlock between them. Sometimes these tests hang because of unexpected PME during transactions. This PME caused by late affinity assignment after cache start. I've added waiting for assignment right after cache start to prevent this unexpected PME.

Ok, I see.
Looks good, should fix the issue.

Thank you, Vitaliy.

dpavlov, agoncharuk, please, help with merge.

VitaliyB thank you for your efforts in fixing tests.

EdShangGG thank you for review.

Merged to master.

Are there any problems in the code that were shown by this test? I mean probably we need to file an issue to fix the code. Or is it the test-only problem?

Github user asfgit closed the pull request at:

https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/4477

dpavlov, thank you.

It was the test-only issue.
